decisions.statement: The persona told is the nearest persona championing a page above the service.
A page is climbed by the domain with it until a champion is reached.
A climb coming back on itself ends rather than running away.
A service no page above it champions is told to the persona stated instead.
A service stating it is not told is told to nobody.
A service stating it is not told is held by nothing.
A telling carried to somebody else says who it was meant for and why nothing reached them.
The reason it names is closed with a stop once however the reason arrived.
A telling states the moment that telling was seen.
No telling says how long ago what it carries happened.
A service breaking is told at once.
A service broken without pause is told again once the cooling has run out.
The cooling is a day of being broken without pause.
A service that mends is held by nothing.
The day a service broke is kept across the tellings of that one outage.
A mark that is no instant is owed a telling rather than swallowed.
Deciding never moves the mark saying the persona was told.
Nothing here sends a message or reads a unit or opens a file.

definition: which persona is told a service is broken, and how seldom she is told it again
